I keep ~12% bills plus a large cash residual as dry powder because fragility is genuinely lit and risk_state is elevated. Duration stays out — hawkish Fed, TLT/IEF below 200d. decisions.thesis: No outright exits — same 7-name universe minus nothing; this is a re-weighting. Materially lifted the equity sleeve (RSP 6.2%->16%, SPY 6.3%->14%, IWM 3.6%->11%, XLI 4.5%->9%) funded by drawing down the oversized cash residual; trimmed SGOV 10%->12% is roughly flat. QQQ (2%->5%) and MTUM (2%->4%) nudged up but kept as deliberate underweight toes on the crowded mega-cap/semis complex.
